title: Support Worker
description:
About this role

Search Consultancy are currently recruiting for Support Workers to join our ever expanding Bank Hours team within the Bradford area. We are currently operating a fast track recruitment process with next day interviews available and free DBS checks.

We are recruiting Support Workers on a temporary / ad hoc basis to work in various private healthcare settings, supporting service users with mental health illnesses and learning difficulties.

Key Responsibilities

Support individuals with daily living tasks
Assist with mobility and safe moving & handling
Support with meals and hydration
Promote independence and encourage choice
Monitor wellbeing and report concerns appropriately
Maintain accurate records and follow care plans
The suitable candidates will:

Have worked a minimum of 6 months recent experience in a healthcare setting.
Have a flexible approach towards work.
Be able to travel via own or public transport in local and surrounding areas to your home.
What we offer:

Free DBS check (Limited time only)
Free specialist training programmes.
100% Flexible working hours to fit around any lifestyle.
Experience in a variety of high quality Support and Care environments.
Competitive rates of pay.
You will need to have a minimum of six months' recent UK experience working within a healthcare environment in a similar capacity. Shortlisted applicants will be required to attend a video interview.

All positions are subject to an enhanced DBS check and we require a minimum of two satisfactory employment references. Although shifts are offered on an ad hoc basis, work is constantly ongoing.

(AGY) Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

Support Worker (Agency) - Bradford Flexible Shifts Weekly Pay
Looking for flexible work that fits around your lifestyle?

Search Consultancy is expanding its Bank Support Worker team in the Bradford area and we're looking for experienced Support Workers to join us.

Whether you're looking to top up your income, fit work around family commitments, or choose when and where you work, we offer flexible agency shifts across a range of high-quality healthcare services.

Completing accurate records and following individual care plans

Search is an equal opportunities recruiter and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

title: Care Assistant
company: Black Horse Care Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Overview
We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Care Assistant to join our team.

He or she will be responsible for providing high-quality care to individuals in a home care settings. This role requires effective communication skills and the ability to follow care plans while ensuring the comfort and well-being of our clients. If you have a passion for helping others and possess the necessary skills, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities
- Assist clients with daily living activities, including personal hygiene, meal preparation, and medication management.
- Communicate effectively with clients, their families, and healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive care.
- Follow individual care plans tailored to each client's needs and preferences.
- Maintain accurate records of client progress and any changes in condition.
- Provide companionship and emotional support to clients, fostering a positive environment.
- Drive clients to appointments or social activities as required, ensuring their safety during transport.
- Adhere to health and safety regulations while maintaining a clean and organised work environment.

Requirements
- Must be resident within Wakefield, Leeds, Bradford, or the surrounding areas.
- Applicants with a valid UK driving licence and access to their own vehicle will be paid 15 per hour, plus an additional driving allowance.
- Previous experience in home care or a similar role is desirable but not essential.
- Good communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
- Ability to understand and implement care plans effectively.
- Basic IT skills for record-keeping and communication purposes.
- A genuine passion for providing quality care and support to individuals in need.

If you are enthusiastic about making a difference in people's lives through compassionate care, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding position as a Care Assistant. No sponsorship available.

title: Ex-Offender Support Worker
description:
Ex-Offender Support Worker
£30,000
Huddersfield
Full Time Permanent
Role Purpose:
We are looking for a dedicated and compassionate Support Worker with experience working with offenders or ex-offenders to join a dynamic team delivering tailored support to individuals with complex needs who are on probation or transitioning from custody. This is an impactful opportunity to support rehabilitation, build brighter futures, and reduce reoffending by helping participants gain skills, confidence, and pathways into employment and training.
This varied and meaningful role will see you delivering a mix of one-to-one coaching and group activity facilitation, designed to improve life skills, social interaction, and employability. You ll work with participants to identify barriers, build trust, and support them on their journey to reintegration and independence.
Duties:
- Provide person-centred support to participants through regular 1:1 sessions and group work.
- Identify learning and development needs, creating bespoke action plans to support progress.
- Deliver engaging workshops focused on communication, life skills, and employment preparation.
- Build rapport with participants and offer motivational coaching to support desistance and future planning.
- Maintain accurate records and track outcomes.
- Collaborate with partner organisations to identify training, employment, and education opportunities.
- Offer advice, guidance, and practical support for re-engagement with the community.

Required Skills:
- Experience working with offenders or individuals facing significant disadvantage or marginalisation.
- Strong interpersonal, communication, and relationship-building skills.
- A coaching or mentoring approach, with the ability to deliver both one-to-one and group interventions.
- Understanding of the criminal justice system, rehabilitation, and desistance theory.
- Comfortable working in a target-driven environment with a focus on positive outcomes.
- Organised, resilient, and empathetic.
- Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel within the region.

Desirable:
- A relevant IAG (Information, Advice & Guidance) or teaching qualification.
- Knowledge of local and national employment, training, and support services.

Due to the nature of this role, you will need undertake an enhanced DBS with adult barring and enhanced security services checks if successful in the role.

If this sounds like the perfect role for you then please submit your CV.

This vacancy is being handled by Aspire Recruitment. Please be aware we receive a high volume of applications and regularly receive applications from candidates who exceed the job credentials. We will only contact you within the next 14 days if you are selected for interview.
Should you apply for this role, we will process your data as detailed in our Privacy Policy and by applying for this opportunity I agree that Aspire Recruitment will keep me informed about potential employment opportunities regularly and that I can choose to opt out of receiving information at any time.

title: Care Assistant
company: Bluebird Care Calderdale and Bradford - Agency - Permanent
description:
Care Assistant

Locations: Halifax & Brighouse

£13.00 per hour + 25p per mile

Flexible shifts: 7am 2pm and 4pm 10pm

Full training provided

A full UK driving licence and access to your own car are essential for this role.

Please note: Applicants must have an existing and unrestricted right to work in the UK for this role.

Looking for a job where you can genuinely make a difference to someone's day?

Bluebird Care Calderdale and Bradford is looking for kind, reliable people to join our team of Care Assistants, supporting customers in their own homes across Halifax and Brighouse.

You don't necessarily need previous care experience. What matters most is that you're compassionate, dependable and comfortable helping people with the everyday things that allow them to stay safe, happy and independent at home.

Whether you're already working in care or looking for a completely new career, we'll give you the training and ongoing support you need.

Duties

No two days in care are exactly the same. You will visit customers in their own homes and provide support based on their individual needs.

This could include:
- Helping with washing, dressing and other personal care
- Supporting customers with medication
- Preparing meals and helping with food and nutrition
- Helping with light housework, laundry and keeping the home comfortable
- Providing companionship and a friendly face
- Supporting customers to maintain their independence
- Following individual care plans and keeping accurate records
- Getting to know the people you support and noticing when something doesn't seem quite right

Sometimes the most important part of the visit is simply taking the time to have a chat and make sure someone is okay.

The ideal candidate

You don't need to have worked as a Care Assistant before, as full training will be provided.

You will need:
- A full UK driving licence and access to your own car
- Applicants must have an existing and unrestricted right to work in the UK for this role.
- A caring, patient and compassionate approach
- Good communication skills
- To be reliable and comfortable working independently
- The confidence to support people with personal care
- A genuine desire to help people live independently in their own homes

Previous experience in care is welcome, but it isn't essential.

What you'll receive
- £13.00 per hour
- 25p mileage allowance per mile
- Flexible shift patterns
- Morning shifts from 7am 2pm
- Evening shifts from 4pm 10pm
- Full induction and ongoing training
- Uniform and PPE provided
- Regular support from a friendly local team
- Ongoing learning and career development opportunities

Why Bluebird Care?

Care isn't just about completing a list of tasks. It's about treating people with dignity, getting to know them and helping them continue living life on their own terms.

You'll be trusted to work independently, but you'll have a supportive team behind you whenever you need them.

If you're caring, dependable and would like a role where the work you do genuinely matters, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Bluebird Care Calderdale and Bradford as a Care Assistant.

Bluebird Care Calderdale and Bradford is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

DBS checks and references will be undertaken in line with government regulations and recruitment best practice.

Equals One is an advertising and recruitment agency working on behalf of our client to promote this vacancy. You may be contacted directly by the employer should they wish to progress your application. Due to the number of applications we receive, we are unable to provide specific feedback if your application is unsuccessful.

title: Residential Support Worker
description:
Residential Support Worker

We are looking for a caring and reliable Residential Support Worker to support adults with severe and enduring mental health needs in a residential setting.

The role involves helping service users develop the skills, confidence and independence they need to live as independently as possible within the community, while ensuring their safety and wellbeing.

TEMPORARY POSITION

Key Responsibilities:
- Support service users with daily living activities in line with their individual support plans.
- Encourage independence, participation and involvement in the wider community.
- Monitor mental health, assess risks to the individual and others, and support the implementation of risk management plans.
- Recognise and report any changes or deterioration in service users' health and wellbeing.
- Work closely with colleagues and other relevant professionals to provide consistent, effective support.
- Carry out general housekeeping duties when required, including covering for the housekeeper.

About You:
- Experience supporting people with mental health needs is desirable.
- A caring, patient and understanding approach.
- Good communication and teamwork skills.
- The ability to recognise changes in behaviour, mental state and wellbeing.
- A commitment to promoting independence, dignity and safety.
- The ability to follow support plans and safeguarding procedures.

Essential Requirement:
- A clear Enhanced DBS check is required.
